name: Cayra MCP
description:
Cayra connects Claude directly to your business database, enabling natural-language queries without writing SQL. Ask questions like "What were last month's top-selling products?" or "Show me overdue invoices by customer" and get instant, data-backed answers.

Cayra supports complex multi-turn conversations, follow-up questions, and analytical queries across all your tables and views. It works with your existing database — no migration or data export required. Each organization connects to their own dedicated Cayra instance, keeping your data private and secure.

Ideal for business teams who need fast answers from their data without relying on technical staff.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cayra MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cayra MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cayra.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cayra MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cayra MCP provides these MCP tools: cayra_agent and health_check.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cayra MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cayra MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Cayra MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cayra MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cayra MCP is developed by Cayra AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
